name: a6-vscodium-tools
description: Headless tool bridge that lets SOC Agent 6 act on the workspace (create/read/write files and folders, manage workspace folders) through VSCodium's own extension API. Commands arrive as file drops in a watched inbox; results are written to an outbox — the same file-drop idiom the SOC bridge already uses.

a6Tools.bridgeDir.description: Directory holding the tool bridge (inbox/outbox/processed). Empty = ~/.a6_vscodium_tools. The A6_TOOLS_DIR environment variable overrides this.

a6Tools.pollMs.description: How often (ms) to scan the inbox for new command files.
